textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 social-science · Climates of India · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Weather changes from day to day. Climate is the average weather of a place over a long period, usually 30 years or more. Each season lasts a few months and recurs every year.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Latitude: the angle at which the sun's rays strike an area. Places near the equator are hot and those near the poles are cold.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 7 social-science · Climates of India · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The monsoon is central to life in India. As summer begins the Asian landmass heats up and a strong low-pressure area forms over it.

beats.en: The monsoon is central to life in India. As summer begins the Asian landmass heats up and a strong low-pressure area forms over it.
beats.speakEn: The monsoon is central to life in India. As summer begins the Asian landmass heats up and a strong low-pressure area forms over it.

beats.en: Our food, clothes, houses, festivals, songs and work are all tied to climate. Farmers depend on the monsoon, and many festivals celebrate the harvest. Climate disasters strain life.
